lines.1: This story is a crossover featuring characters from the Ane, Chanto Shiyou yo! series and Tsuyokiss.
lines.2: It was made on the assumption that you've played the Ane, Chanto Shiyou yo! series, so anyone unfamiliar with it is guaranteed to be left behind. Please understand.
lines.4: Two large motorcycles pulled up in front of Ryuumeikan.
lines.6: 「But Serori, are you really going inside?」
lines.7: 「Pretty much. The client wants me to investigate school life too.」
lines.8: 「And if you're a detective, this is where you go in.」
lines.9: 「The pay's great, too. Time to show them just how light I am on my feet.」
lines.10: 「But sneaking into a school is... still wrong.」
lines.12: 「All right, I'm off, nya. If I get caught, come pick me up!」
lines.14: 「Ah, no. That's not it. Don't go in.」
lines.16: 「She went in... Auu... Will she be okay?」
lines.19: 「Even if you're in a hurry, you need to keep things like this in order.」
lines.20: 「You don't want the Princess getting fed up with you, do you?」
lines.21: 「Yeah. But if I worried about my appearance, I was going to be late.」
lines.22: 「Being late or looking presentable. Which one should I pick?」
lines.23: 「Just wake up earlier, you spineless fool.」
lines.24: She gave me a light knock on the head.
lines.26: 「Now get back to class. Homeroom is about to sta--」
lines.32: 「Forty... fifty meters east. They jumped over the wall.」
lines.36: 「Now then... The target was Class 2-C, nya.」
lines.40: 「You're not a student here, are you? May I see your entry permit?」
lines.41: 「Hehe. Pretty sharp eyes if you managed to spot me. You're one of those disciplinary committee people?」
lines.44: A blonde ponytail, just like the Princess.
lines.45: Where the Princess had an intellectual beauty, this woman had a wild sort of allure.
lines.47: Even Otome was momentarily captivated by her looks.
lines.51: Despite the blonde hair, she moved with the agility of a Japanese ninja.
lines.52: She scampered straight up the wall and reached the roof in no time.
lines.54: If her opponent hadn't been Otome, she probably would have gotten away.
lines.55: 「Can't let them throw me out yet. He who runs away lives to win another day!」
lines.57: 「Unnatural attempt to flee. You are now classified as an intruder.」
lines.58: The iron disciplinarian reached out to seize the intruder.
lines.59: 「Whoa there! Like I'm gonna let you catch me!」
lines.60: The intruder knocked aside the reaching hand and countered.
lines.61: Their hands clashed hard enough to seem to throw sparks.
lines.63: 「That was dangerous. Looks like you're no ordinary student, nya.」
lines.64: 「And you are clearly no ordinary intruder. Increasing force. Moving to apprehend.」
lines.67: The intruder dodged the fist with animal-like agility.
lines.69: 「If you want violence, I'll answer with violence!」
lines.71: Fists rained down like a storm.
lines.72: 「A flurry of blows...? Depending on sheer volume is far too soft!」
lines.73: Otome swept the barrage aside with her hands.
lines.76: A finishing blow came crashing down.
lines.78: The blonde woman leapt down from the roof.
lines.79: Otome followed with movements that looked like wire-fu.
lines.80: No wonder people said her very existence was cheating.
lines.83: 「Tomoe, we're getting out of here! Some weirdo found me!!」
lines.85: 「Quit dawdling, nya! I'll leave you behind!」
lines.88: 「At that motorcycle's speed... I could catch them on foot, but I can't rule out more accomplices. They only just entered and nothing appears to have been stolen.」
lines.91: 「Not a scratch. Leo, go to your classroom.」
lines.93: 「Still, I can't believe even you let an intruder get away.」
lines.94: 「Indeed. I wasn't fighting in earnest, but it's been a long time since someone parried every attack I made.」
lines.95: 「And that wasn't martial arts. It was a nonsensical style relying entirely on raw athletic ability.」
lines.97: 「...Still, there seem to be an awful lot of strange people with blonde ponytails.」
lines.99: 「We should be safe this far away, nya.」
lines.100: 「Still, that was amazing. I never thought I'd see someone who could make you run away, Serori.」
lines.101: 「Mm. Even if I'd fought seriously, she would've been pretty dangerous. The world's endlessly huge.」
lines.103: 「But I'm not giving up! The pay is way too good!」
lines.104: 「We have time, right? You don't need to rush.」
lines.108: 「Whether she's useful as an adviser is another question.」
